description: Border crossing points: Afghanistan is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency. The situation inside Afghanistan deteriorated in 2021 and had significant consequences for the most vulnerable among the population. Iran and Pakistan, which are neighbours of Afghanistan, also host some 8.2 million registered Afghan refugees and other Afghans with different statuses. Coverage: Afghanistan. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher UNHCR - The UN Refugee Agency. Its tags are education, facilities-infrastructure, livelihoods, needs assessment, protection. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, WEB APP. The portal shows 2024-01-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
